definition: Stage distinguishes original, intermediate, continued and reassembled occurrences. A function bearer : Stage → B assigns an object to each occurrence; ordinary equality of B represents numerical identity. Different stage constructors do not entail different bearers. No claim about the adequacy of this persistent-object representation is implicit.
note: Analytical Theseus reassembly profile; not attributed to Plutarch. See docs/notes/theseus-identity-boundary.md.
